# Q15 prospective external-cohort contract

**Status:** metadata and analysis design only; no Lee2019_MI or Cho2017 classifier results have been generated by this packet. Q14-R2FINAL independent validation must pass before Q14 is cited as validated. The cloud is currently off; this packet neither starts training nor changes already published Q14 data. The Q14 R2 `failed_stopped` receipt stays in the record.

## Decision hierarchy before any new target scores

1. `Q15-V001` (Lee2019_MI) and `Q15-V002` (Cho2017) are metadata-only audits. Record provider release/version, raw file hash, subject/session/run inventory, acquisition sampling rates, channel names/reference/units, cue/event time origin, class labels, duration available after each cue, event-to-trial identity, and permission to publish derived predictions. A metadata audit may inspect **label definitions and counts**, but never calculate model predictions or classification performance. Save a signed/versioned receipt and deterministic inclusion table. Missing/corrupt files cause a documented block, not a silent subject exclusion.
2. Require the exact ordered Q14 EEG channel list `Fz, FC3, FC1, FCz, FC2, FC4, C5, C3, C1, Cz, C2, C4, C6, CP3, CP1, CPz, CP2, CP4, P1, Pz, P2, POz`, left/right hand MI only, cue-aligned trial identities, correct physical units, and no unlabeled evaluation runs. If any required channel, time origin, or task label is incompatible, **block the corresponding zero-shot arm** and write a versioned amendment before outcomes. Never choose a convenient channel subset from observed model scores.
3. Freeze both prospective branches, code, checkpoint IDs/hashes, preprocessing, exclusion rule, subject list, contrast direction, seeds and statistical script in Git before **either Lee or Cho prediction**. If the shorter-source model must be trained, freeze it first. No branch choice may depend on external BA. This is prospective replication after PhysioNet was inspected; it does not restore preregistration to the earlier BNCI analyses.

## Q15-E001: original Q14 source model to Lee2019_MI

- Eligible only if `Q15-V001` proves exact compatibility with Q14's 22 EEG channels and cue-relative `[0.5,3.5)` second window. Lee's documented left/right task lasts 4 seconds, so this window is *plausible*, not yet validated against raw event timing.
- Reuse the **exact Q14-E002 source-only frozen checkpoints, CSP pipeline, epoch choices, three final seeds, 8–30 / 8–13 / 13–30 Hz bands, zero-phase run-local filter, 160-Hz target rate, unit scaling, fixed ordered channels, and class mapping**. Independently verify raw hashes and selected checkpoints before inference. Do not fit a Lee reference, whitener, scaler, aligner, channel interpolator, prior, or batch-normalization statistics.
- Use `Lee2019_MI(train_run=True, test_run=False, resting_state=False)` or an equivalently audited loader. The official MOABB documentation states that MI online test runs lack trial labels; those runs cannot be scored. Report the two Lee sessions **per subject as well as pooled within subject**; do not count 108 subject-sessions as 108 independent people.
- One row per subject × run × trial × model × seed with full binary probabilities, predicted label, true label, cue/event identity, file hash and model hash. Exactly zero external target fits. If the input contract fails, status is `blocked_incompatible_metadata`, not a negative decoding result.

## Q15-E002/E003/E004: metadata-driven 2-second common-window branch

- Cho2017's documented MI task window is 3 seconds. Therefore the original Q14 cue-relative `[0.5,3.5)` endpoint is not an in-task Cho test. **Before seeing either new cohort's scores**, define a separate source contract with cue-relative `[0.5,2.5)` seconds, two seconds/320 samples after anti-aliased resampling to 160 Hz; same original Q14 ordered 22 channels only if both metadata audits pass; left/right MI; same Q14 frequency bands, filter order/phase, artifact inclusion, fixed architecture hyperparameters except required `n_times=320`, seeds, source-only epoch rule and metrics. This is a new experiment ID, never an edit of Q14.
- `Q15-E002`: BNCI2014_001 nine source subjects only. Two neural arms each use four fixed BNCI subject-only inner groups at selection seed `20260923` and three final seeds `20260924/25/26` (2 × [4+3] = **14** neural fits); one frozen-hyperparameter CSP4+LDA source fit (**1** shallow fit). Save all source fit IDs, curves, checkpoint hashes, code/environment and a source-freeze receipt. The new model is not trained on PhysioNet, Lee or Cho.
- `Q15-E003` and `Q15-E004`: infer the same frozen Q15-E002 model on Cho and Lee, respectively, without target fit. Freeze cohort inclusion/metadata before either cohort's outcome is read. Compare the two cohorts separately; Lee's original-Q14 3-second and new-2-second analyses are two correlated views of one cohort, not independent replication events. If all 22 channels are unavailable in either cohort, block this common-window branch and write a new metadata-only amendment; **do not** select an intersection after seeing scores.
- Source-only BNCI 2-second LOSO characterization can be separately planned if required for a paper table. It is *not* in the minimal 14+1 source-freeze count, and cannot be smuggled into the zero-shot queue as already complete.

## Interpretation and independent validation

The primary comparison direction stays `MU_BETA_SHARED − BROAD_EEGNET` in per-subject balanced accuracy after averaging the same three frozen seeds. The CSP arm is a context comparator. Binary chance BA is 0.5; none of these cohorts tests four-class tongue decoding. Report every eligible subject, dataset-specific confusion matrices, class recalls, missed/failed files, session strata where present, and bootstrap CI based on *subjects*. A second dataset is a replication opportunity, not a license to revise the model. Across PhysioNet, Lee and Cho, source model and window differ for the 2-second branch; show a contract column and avoid a pooled claim of one identical frozen model across all three. An independent validator must reconstruct event/trial identities from checksum-verified raw files, enforce zero target fits, probability/argmax validity, model hashes, coverage and all subject-level statistics. No scientific `passed` receipt may be issued from a batch-orchestration receipt alone.

Primary documentation: [MOABB Lee2019_MI](https://moabb.neurotechx.com/docs/generated/moabb.datasets.Lee2019_MI.html) (54 subjects, two sessions, 62 EEG, 1,000 Hz, 4-second MI and unlabeled online MI test runs); [MOABB Cho2017](https://moabb.neurotechx.com/docs/generated/moabb.datasets.Cho2017.html) (52 subjects, one session, 64 EEG, 512 Hz, 3-second left/right MI); [PhysioNet EEGMMIDB](https://physionet.org/content/eegmmidb/1.0.0/). Provider summaries are not substitutes for local raw-file metadata receipts.
